description.value: The Pemberton & District Community Centre is a municipally operated recreation hub serving Pemberton and the surrounding district, offering fitness classes, drop-in activities, and programs for all ages. It houses a fitness centre and is the primary indoor recreation facility for the community at the base of the Sea-to-Sky corridor north of Whistler. Accessible recreation programming is listed as a service, and the OSM record notes wheelchair accessibility.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (12 spaces) at 48m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active municipal recreation facility ('Your Hub for Recreation, Wellness & Community Connection') with a fitness centre and community programs. A name mismatch exists: OSM records 'Pemberton Community Centre' while the website consistently uses 'Pemberton & District Community Centre'.

blurb: Pemberton's community centre and fitness hub.
